description: Prompts the deterministic router misroutes today. Not counted as routing coverage. Each must keep reproducing its recorded misroute; when a routing fix makes one pass, tooling/routing_coverage.py --check fails until it is moved into suite.json.

cases.prompt: Convert this ebook from EPUB to MOBI.
cases.reason: A file-format conversion needs no skill; ebook-publisher's description excludes simple PDF/file handling but its bare noun signal still fires

cases.prompt: Add canonical tags to the blog templates.
cases.reason: seo-geo-aeo-maxxing excludes isolated schema/meta tasks, yet its unanchored 'canonical' signal fires on any canonical mention

cases.prompt: Given the current roadmap for this one product, what should the team ship this week?
cases.reason: product-operator's 'ship .* this week' pattern needs a word between 'ship' and 'this week', so the plainest phrasing routes to no skill
